scope: Local retrospective candidate-ranking pilot with the available historical2431 no-ITrace joint model; no base-model training or MD and no manuscript change.

known_information_at_freeze.claim: A retrospective panel selected for available structure and real binding measurements; not a prospective blinded antigen design trial.

base_model.input_code_contract: AA identity plus N/CA/C/O backbone. Repacking sidechains at identical identity/backbone cannot change the model input; mutation-only fixed-backbone results are environment-conditioned sequence responses, not newly sampled conformations.
base_model.name: historical strict_full fold0 no-ITrace joint model
base_model.scientific_role: Availability-limited local pilot. It does not reproduce the current manuscript 2430 checkpoint and must be labelled as the historical 2431 model in all results.

nyeso.reason: The 9V analogue is the common background of this existing mutation panel, chosen from candidate identities/source constants before model outputs. The C9 and L9 peptides are candidates relative to 9V. Native NY-ESO-1 9C is not silently renamed WT.

tax.extra_structure_not_primary: 1QRN lacks a corresponding verified affinity in the source constants; no positive label inferred from structural availability.

label_contract.unit_of_analysis: Unique (TCR construct, HLA allele, peptide sequence, comparable assay condition), collapsed to one candidate only after assay-comparability verification.
label_contract.primary_assay: Direct monomeric TCR-pMHC SPR equilibrium KD; exclude pMHC stability/loading, 2D affinity, EC50, cytokine and cytotoxicity measurements from this outcome.
label_contract.unit_conversion: Recompute pKD=-log10(KD in mol/L) from original KD and original units; microM->M factor1e-6. Do not trust a CSV -log10 column without unit checks.
label_contract.primary_outcome: delta_pKD = pKD(candidate)-pKD(parent) measured with the same TCR/HLA and within the same study/assay/temperature. Higher means stronger TCR binding.
label_contract.duplicate_measurements: Retain raw study/assay/temperature/replicate rows. Average technical-replicate pKD only within one condition, then form its within-condition parent difference. If verified comparable independent studies cover a candidate, use their median within-study delta, retaining each study separately for sensitivity.
label_contract.prohibition: Do not unconditionally average all same-sequence pKD across studies as the downloaded split_csv.py does. The downloaded template-specific/closest/averaged CSVs are not independent experiments and cannot add sample size.
label_contract.missing_parent: Do not subtract a parent measured in another study to fabricate a matched primary delta. Record exclusion from primary delta analysis. Verified absolute pKD may be shown separately with study strata.
label_contract.censoring: Any >KD, <KD, no binding or above detection row is interval-censored; do not convert its bound to an exact regression target. Keep in a separate all-candidate ranking table; score a pair only when the measured intervals imply an ordering.
label_contract.conflict: If published primary source and repackaged CSV disagree, primary source governs, the discrepancy stays in the audit, and eligibility is decided before viewing predictions.
label_contract.freeze_gate: A label-only eligibility table and source citations must be hashed before mutant model predictions. If primary-eligible single mutants are fewer than8 or fewer than3 occupied positions in either system, do not fit or report a primary trained candidate-ranking model; report descriptive feasibility only.
label_contract.Pettmann_primary_fit: Original-study reported hybrid: use constrained KD if constrained KD>20 microM, otherwise Bmax-fitted KD. This is the published Methods rule, not a model-performance choice.
label_contract.measurement_batch_status: Study/protocol/37C equivalence confirmed in source curation, but per-candidate shared-run/batch IDs are not supplied. Do not describe these as known same-batch measurements.
label_contract.study_sensitivity: Report each 1G4 study separately in addition to candidate-level median within-study delta. Do not use study identity as a predictive feature or increase independent n for multiple study rows.

structure_contract.primary: One common fixed-backbone experimental template per system; mutate every eligible sequence, including the parent, with the same label-blind deterministic sidechain preparation and the same atom/chain selection.
structure_contract.template_choice: 2BNQ and1AO7 fixed in advance. Do not select candidate-specific closest templates, best conformers, templates with the best KD, or templates with best observed model agreement.
structure_contract.molecular_roles: Record and verify peptide, HLA heavy chain, beta2m, TCRalpha and TCRbeta individually per structure. No chainletter-only assumption across new files. Verify model-parsed sequence, residue counts, N/CA/C masks and chain order.
structure_contract.coverage: All nine peptide residues and all fixed environmental feature residues must have valid N/CA/C frames in both parent and candidate; otherwise exclude from numerical scoring by a recorded QC rule, never by affinity or prediction. Keep every excluded candidate in the accounting table.
structure_contract.multiple_conformers: If deterministic preparation yields multiple conformers, predeclare their count and aggregation before inference; average them to one candidate score. Never treat them as experimental replicates or choose by affinity.
structure_contract.sensitivity: Apply every listed sensitivity template to every candidate; within each template calculate candidate-minus-parent features. Show each template separately; optionally fixed equal-weight mean of delta features across all listed templates. No sensitivity result replaces the primary on the basis of accuracy.

fixed_regions.environment_U: For each primary template: all unchanged HLA-heavy-chain and TCRalpha/beta residues with any reference heavy atom within8.0 Angstrom of any reference peptide heavy atom. Exclude beta2m. Determine once from parent before mutation and use the identical residue set for every candidate.
fixed_regions.RMSF_valid: Every U residue with valid N/CA/C frame, fixed across candidates.
fixed_regions.Hchi_valid: U residues with at least one chemically defined sidechain chi (exclude Gly/Ala), valid frame and complete canonical atom identity. U contains no substituted residues.
fixed_regions.reason: The primary Hchi feature is measured on chemically unchanged environmental residues, so a different number/type of sidechain angles at the substituted peptide is not mistaken for environment sensitivity.
fixed_regions.archive_only: Also archive full-peptide absolute profiles, per-residue U profiles and separate HLA/TCR summaries. Their maxima, signs, selected residues and alternate radii are not eligible to replace the fixed primary features after seeing outcomes.

static_definitions.BSA: [SASA(TCRalpha+beta)+SASA(pMHC incl beta2m)-SASA(full complex)]/2; solvent probe1.4A, fixed Shrake-Rupley960 sphere points per heavy atom, identical atomic radii and preparation for every candidate. Candidate-minus-parent.
static_definitions.contacts: Number of unique (peptide residue,TCRalpha/beta residue) pairs having at least one non-H atom distance<=4.5A; count each pair once; candidate-minus-parent.
static_definitions.no_static_features: If sidechain completeness or SASA implementation is unavailable, label sequence-only+dynamic analysis as a restricted feasibility analysis; do not claim increment beyond a static structural baseline. A fixed-backbone CA-only contact baseline is invariant and is disclosed, not sold as a strong structural comparator.

prohibited_features: study identity as a predictive feature
Hchi standard deviations as cross-system calibrated uncertainty

primary_split.name: within_system_leave_one_single_mutation_position_out
primary_split.eligibility: Single amino-acid substitutions relative to the fixed parent, after label-only primary eligibility. Every substitution at a held-out position is tested together. Multiple substitutions and the parent do not enter fitting.
primary_split.multiple_mutants: Fit the prespecified model once on all eligible primary single substitutions of that system, then predict the prelisted two A6 double substitutions as a separate compositional interpolation check; do not merge them into primary metrics or claim position extrapolation.

calibrator.feature_scaling: For each fold, divide each column by sqrt(mean_training[x^2]); do not center delta features. A zero-RMS training feature remains zero with scale1. Apply these training scales to heldout features without recomputation.
calibrator.target_scaling: None; delta_pKD has the same logarithmic unit in both systems.
calibrator.implementation: Solve beta=(Xscaled^T Xscaled+n_train*I)^-1 Xscaled^T y by a linear solver; the n_train factor implements the mean-loss lambda exactly.
calibrator.signs: Learn coefficient signs only from training positions; neither lower Hchi nor lower RMSF is assumed universally to improve binding.

secondary_transport.name: two_direction_cross_system_transport
secondary_transport.training: Eligible single substitutions of the source system only, same fixed ridge/lambda/features, source-only scales, source-only labels.
secondary_transport.test: All eligible single substitutions of the other system; no target outcomes used for feature selection, signs, scales, intercept or template.
secondary_transport.reporting: Both directions separately; only two related HLA-A2 systems exist, so this is an exploratory transport check, not an estimate of population-level cross-TCR generalization.
secondary_transport.not_primary: No claim may be rescued by choosing the successful direction or pooling source-trained fitted values with heldout values.

metrics.primary: Candidate-level out-of-fold MAE(delta_pKD), separately for1G4 andA6; positive increment=MAE(sequence+static)-MAE(sequence+static+R+H).
metrics.mandatory_ablation: Report corresponding MAE for +R and +H and the joint-minus-each increment. Joint improvement over baseline alone does not show that both readouts are necessary.
secondary: Candidate-level out-of-fold Spearman rho, separately by system
Concordant proportion over all comparable candidate pairs with known experimental order, separately by system
Top3 overlap for the finite eligible primary single-mutant list; show entire ranked list, not just hits
Each mutation-position fold MAE and its test candidate count
Absolute MAE and incremental MAE against zero-change prediction
metrics.aggregation: Each candidate contributes once to its system primary metric. A two-system macro mean may summarize, alongside both system values and candidate counts. No residue count, conformer count, or template count enters experimental n.
metrics.no_binary_endpoint: Do not manufacture ACC/AUROC/PR-AUC by choosing an affinity threshold after seeing scores. No classification primary endpoint is defined for these tiny continuous-SPR panels.
metrics.uncertainty: No p-value, residue-bootstrap CI, pooled-pair significance or two-system bootstrap generalization CI. Show candidate-level errors, published measurement spread and six held-position errors; state these are a finite retrospective panel.
metrics.joint_claim_rule: A consistent joint increment requires lower primary MAE than sequence+static in both systems; evidence that the two readouts add complementary information additionally requires joint MAE lower than each one-readout ablation in both systems. Otherwise describe exactly which system/readout helped, and do not claim a universal joint benefit. Always report magnitude and ordering, not only the direction of improvement.

leakage_gates: Downloaded/copied local checkpoint bytes must equal b3eed060919df15f075329bc892f959d9355232be5feb561417edd49ea82b39f before pilot inference.

Actual historical train manifest SHA must equal e0c84c566dea09b436dd7d07e9e6fd8ce1a8cf0c72be20931179e6689c8b44bd, with2431 records and0 ITrace; disclose the single indirect transitive-family member A00IL.

Final prepared reference/candidate parsed sequences and fixed U must be audited against the exact training inventory; raw template/MD topology audits alone do not substitute for final-input verification.
No candidate outcome is used in structural preparation, rotamer/template choice, region selection, hyperparameter fitting outside the training fold, calibration scaling or exclusion.
No duplicate sequence, WT row, template or alternate conformer appears as another independent test candidate.
All label/source and structure eligibility changes after the protocol freeze must be versioned with reasons and dated before inspecting the affected model result.
deliverables: candidate-level eligibility and source table with censored/excluded rows
fixed candidate splits and all fold predictions
all seven fixed model comparisons and raw candidate features
per-template sensitivity results with identical candidate scope
training overlap and local-only execution audit
complete negative results and mechanism limits
interpretation: A successful pilot would support feasibility of candidate-ranking features from this historical2431 model in two known TCR/HLA contexts. It would not reproduce the manuscript2430 model, establish fully family-disjoint validation, novel-antigen discovery, T-cell activation, safety, broad TCR generalization, binding free energy, or causal Hchi-to-RMSF transmission.

amendments.reason: Primary source retrieved and Methods explicitly selects hybrid KD. Initial protocol required primary source governs and had not selected a fit version.
amendments.rule_quote: For constrained KD above 20 μM, we reported the constrained KD, otherwise we use the Bmax fitted KD.
